title: Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate
function: Hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this hydrogen hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with SPC sampling
TIG welding all positions with SPC sampling
DPI dye penetrant inspect with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for hydrogen fuel cell application
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for hydrogen fuel cell performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate suitable for Hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate?
faq.a: Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address hydrogen hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for hydrogen fuel cell requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. hydrogen fuel cell components require Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for hydrogen fuel cell application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet hydrogen fuel cell specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Fuel cell plate / Stack end plate hydrogen hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
